public_clauses: The blue pitcher must be held in the gripper and lifted so that all of it is clear above the table top, still over the table.

notes.detail: no face of the blue pitcher fits the open gripper (85 mm); a grasp needs a rim, handle, stem or edge

witness_plan.note: each case starts from a fresh reset of seed 0; the robot holds its reset pose with the gripper open unless a case grasps; success is any official result over the case's ticks
witness_plan.plan_fix: 2026-11-15: the pitcher (19 cm across) is wider than the open jaw (8.5 cm); the generated grasp put its near 2 cm between the pads and the jaw closed on nothing (11-05 witness and the 11-15 probe). Other axis orders only registered contact by setting the pitcher across the open pads. The case holds it upright by the rim: its height along the approach (order [0, 2, 1], flipped upright), moved 8 cm along the jaw line so one wall lies between the pads, which close on it.
